sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 2 December 2024, pitch SYN-SYNCP000050-P1 was put before Silver Oak Medical Group 050 on behalf of SEQIRUS.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 3 rebate of 5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Influenza minimum take of 670 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
